integrity: Proof and finite verifier are supplied; exact integer observations are distinguished from universal assertions; no claim of independent review or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: The base is fixed and at least 3; only longest consecutive runs are classified, not shorter runs; asymptotics hold in digit-length shells and have no single global positive constant. Uses a cited, full-text-inspected boundary classification. General restricted-digit equidistribution is pre-existing. No independent mathematical validation.
title: Fractal census of maximum consecutive runs of b-prodigious integers
